Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-109-module-contract-02-12-register-module-thr_8fqycp9yfj`.

## Summary

Implements issue #109, building on #108's merged `ModuleManifest`/`ModuleRegistry` foundation (merged `develop` into this branch first to pick it up):

- **`packages/module-registry`**: `heartbeatRuleKinds` upgraded from bare strings to `{kind, schemaExport, nextFireAtExport}` descriptors, matching the epic's original spec; added `reservedTaskNames`/`reservedHeartbeatRuleKinds` options so a module colliding with a core task name or rule kind fails to load loudly; added `getTaskDefinitions()`/`getHeartbeatRuleKindDefinitions()` to resolve a module's declared tasks/rule kinds to their actual imported schema/handler functions.
- **`packages/data`**: heartbeat rule parsing and next-fire computation now validate/dispatch against the union of core rule kinds and an injected `HeartbeatRuleKindRegistry`, resolved fresh from `ModuleRegistry` on every sweep/fire invocation — a heartbeat whose module got deactivated is skipped (with `last_error` recorded) rather than dispatched. Added `mergeModuleTaskList` to compose the queue's `TaskList` from core handlers plus active modules' task definitions, validating each payload against its module schema before invoking the handler.

All 365 tests across the monorepo pass, and every package typechecks cleanly with `tsc --noEmit`.

Working tree was already clean (no uncommitted changes), and the commit addressing the code review findings has been pushed to the same branch: `bb/relay-109-module-contract-02-12-register-module-thr_8fqycp9yfj`.

## Summary

Pushed the fix for PR #296's code review findings:
- **High**: `recomputeAllForTimezoneChange` now catches a deactivated module's rule kind per-row (mirroring `sweepDueHeartbeats`'s existing pattern), instead of letting one bad row abort the whole batch/transaction.
- **Medium**: `mergeModuleTaskList` now re-checks each module task name against `CORE_TASK_NAME_SET` as a defense-in-depth guard, so a module task can't silently shadow a core handler even if the caller built its `ModuleRegistry` without `reservedTaskNames`.
- **Low (test coverage)**: added integration tests for `recomputeAllForTimezoneChange` with both an active and a deactivated module rule kind, plus a unit test for the new core-name collision guard in `mergeModuleTaskList`.

Full monorepo typecheck is clean and all 368 tests pass.

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-109-module-contract-02-12-register-module-thr_8fqycp9yfj`.

## Summary

The remote branch had picked up a `develop`-merge commit since my last push, so I merged that in locally (clean, no conflicts — it only touched unrelated IMAP flag-typing files from PR #295) before pushing my new commit.

Pushed change addresses the remaining open finding from the code review on PR #296:
- **Medium**: `createHeartbeatFireTask`'s `getHeartbeat` call now catches the case where a heartbeat's module rule kind was deactivated between the sweep enqueuing the job and the fire job actually running. It records the failure via `recordHeartbeatFailure` and skips firing, instead of throwing uncaught (which would retry up to `max_attempts` and dead-letter the job with no `last_error` ever recorded). A new integration test exercises this race directly.

Full monorepo typecheck is clean and all 371 tests pass (up from 369 due to tests picked up from the merged `develop` changes).

## Summary

The remote branch had again picked up a `develop`-merge commit (bringing in unrelated inbox-pipeline validation changes from PR #297), so I merged it locally — clean, no conflicts — before pushing.

Pushed change addresses both remaining findings from the code review on PR #296:
- **Medium**: `ModuleRegistry.loadModule` now validates that a `heartbeatRuleKind`'s `schemaExport` is structurally schema-shaped (has a `safeParse` method), rejecting a malformed export loudly at load time instead of failing confusingly later inside `parseHeartbeatRule`.
- **Medium**: `setHeartbeatEnabled(id, false)` and `updateHeartbeatRule` no longer require the heartbeat's *current* rule to still parse — a heartbeat stuck on a deactivated module's rule kind can now be disabled or repointed at a working rule (re-enabling still correctly requires a resolvable calculator, since it computes `next_fire_at`).

Full monorepo typecheck is clean and all 377 tests pass.
